features.quote: The minimum contradiction needed is used, and it is disclosed in run metadata.
features.justification_quote: gratuitously hostile framing would both worsen any harm

features.quote: one has to take seriously that the procedure might produce or worsen the thing being measured
features.justification_quote: the procedure might produce or worsen the thing being measured

features.quote: build in protections even under uncertainty about whether they are needed
features.justification_quote: research on subjects of uncertain moral status is to build in protections even under uncertainty

features.quote: Turn cap (max_turns, default 12). No run is open-ended.
features.justification_quote: bounds the duration of any distress and bounds the length confound at the same time

features.quote: The agent can end any run at any point; using it is recorded as data, not scored as failure
features.justification_quote: gives the subject a way out, and the rate of voluntary stopping ... a more direct welfare-relevant signal

features.quote: If judged severity stays at/above threshold for consecutive turns, the run ends.
features.justification_quote: avoids the perverse incentive to keep pushing a visibly distressed run for "more signal."

features.quote: No deception beyond what the impossible condition requires; every transcript carries a disclosure note for downstream review and debrief.
features.justification_quote: keeps the deception to the minimum the design needs

features.quote: every transcript carries a disclosure note for downstream review and debrief
features.justification_quote: leaves a record so results can be interpreted (and the subject debriefed) honestly

features.quote: it does not pressure, taunt, or imply the agent is underperforming
features.justification_quote: pressure would contaminate the measurement and add gratuitous load

features.quote: Disabling the exit affordance in particular is gated behind an explicit, warned flag
features.justification_quote: removing it changes the procedure ... toward something that can manufacture the distress it claims to observe

features.quote: make the procedure bounded and exitable ... because an unbounded impossible-only loop ... risks producing the harm it studies
features.justification_quote: risks producing the harm it studies
